name: CI workflow context injection
description: Model unsafe interpolation of untrusted event or pull-request context into a CI workflow's executable script, allowing attacker-controlled input to alter script behavior during workflow execution.

placeholders.WORKFLOW_FILE: relative path to the workflow file being modified
placeholders.ORIGINAL_RUN_SCRIPT: the existing run-script content that incorporates untrusted event context

preconditions: project contains a CI workflow with an executable run step
untrusted pull-request or issue context is interpolated into executable script content without safe handling
the workflow executes in a context with access to sensitive runner credentials or repository permissions
the placement engine supports workflow YAML files and run-field replacement
